items.name: pilot/terminal_denied
items.title: Terminal denied, comparison
items.prompt: Two short low electronic error beeps from an old computer terminal. Clear soft square-wave tones with a little gritty texture. Isolated sound, short quiet tail. No speech, no music.

items.name: pilot/melee_hit_body
items.title: Body impact, comparison
items.prompt: A single heavy gloved punch landing on a padded body. Deep solid thud and a little clothing snap. Close dry foley, quiet after the hit. No voices, no music.

items.name: pilot/impact_steel
items.title: Steel impact, comparison
items.prompt: A single bullet impact on a thick steel plate. Loud sharp metallic clang that quickly dies away, small bright ricochet tick. Close dry sound. No firing sound, no music.

items.name: pilot/fire_scatter
items.title: Scatter shot, comparison
items.prompt: One powerful shotgun blast with a hard initial crack, deep tight punch and short gritty decay. Dry close perspective, quiet after the blast. No reloading, no music.
